## Summary

Gather historical and projected biomass model results and summarize into a mean/sd layer showing relative change in biomass.

Gapfill to ensure coastal coverage and then project to Behrmann 5 km.

## Data

* Multiple biomass models from ISIMIP: .nc files from https://data.isimip.org/search/tree/ISIMIP3b
* See `data_access_isimip` script for download
* NetCDF files stored in `_data/isimip_2026/rasts/` with `_data/isimip_2026/filelist.txt` for filenames

## Methods

```{r attach packages}
#| message: false
#| 
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(collapse)
library(here)
library(terra)

source(here('common_fxns.R'))
```


### Set up analysis

For the main result, focus on the Total Consumer Biomass layers (not by size class or depth layer). TCB is available for all models.

```{r}
scenarios_df <- read_csv(here('_data/isimip_2026/scenario_files.csv')) |> 
  mutate(base_f = basename(f))

rast_df <- data.frame(repo_file = list.files(here('_data/isimip_2026/rasts'), 
                                                full.names = TRUE)) |> 
  mutate(base_f = basename(repo_file)) |> 
  inner_join(scenarios_df, by = 'base_f') |> 
  select(-base_f)
```

Helper functions: 

* `grab_rast_layers()` accesses a single `.nc` file and pulls specific years from it, then calculates mean/sd over all increments.

```{r raster processing function}
grab_rast_layers <- function(m, d, c, s = 'nat', v, y) {
  df <- rast_df ### from global

  rast_f <- df |> 
    filter(model == m & climate_driver == d & climate_scenario == c & socioecon_scenario == s & variable == v) |> 
    pull(repo_file)
  if(length(rast_f) > 1) stop('only one layer plz')
  if(length(rast_f) == 0) stop('no layer found')
  r <- rast(rast_f)

  yrs <- convert_years(r, c)

  idx <- which(yrs >= min(y) & yrs <= max(y))
  if(length(idx) == 0) stop('no years found')
  r_sub <- r[[idx]]

  return(r_sub)
}

convert_years <- function(r, c) {
  ### some historical layers have screwed up years...
  ### some have time as a Date object, others not so much?  
  ### * dbpm has Date check how that works
  ### * boats and apecosm seem to have numeric?
  r_time <- terra::time(r)
  # browser()
  if(class(r_time) == 'Date') r_time <- lubridate::year(r_time)
  if(c == 'historical' & max(floor(r_time)) != 2014) {
    offset <- floor(2014 - max(r_time))
    r_time <- r_time + offset + 1
  } else if(c == 'ssp585' & max(floor(r_time)) != 2100) {
    offset <- floor(2100 - max(r_time))
    r_time <- r_time + offset + 1
  }
  return(floor(r_time))
} 
```

### Process biomass layers

Best practice for ISIMIP ensemble model:

* Collapse drivers within each model (so models with two drivers don't dominate)
* Calculate relative change per model, not absolute biomass
* Then calc summary stats across all models, including mean, SD, and agreement (how many models agree on the direction of change) 

#### Calculate absolute biomass change per model

For each given model/driver combination, load historical layers and projected layers.  Calc mean difference.
```{r}
mdl_driver_df <- rast_df |> 
  select(model, climate_driver) |> 
  distinct()

mvec <- mdl_driver_df$model |> unique()
mdl_rast_list <- vector('list', length = length(mvec)) |> 
  setNames(mvec)
for(m in mvec) {
  ### m <- mvec[1]
  mdl_df <- mdl_driver_df |> filter(model == m)
  dvec <- mdl_df$climate_driver |> unique()
  drv_rast_list <- vector('list', length = length(dvec)) |> 
    setNames(dvec)
  for(d in dvec) {
    ### d <- dvec[1]

    ### Load historical and projected layers
    hist_r <- grab_rast_layers(m = m, d = d, c = 'historical', v = 'tcb', y = c(2005, 2014))
    proj_r <- grab_rast_layers(m = m, d = d, c = 'ssp585', v = 'tcb', y = c(2046, 2055))
    
    ### Calculate mean difference
    hist_r_mean <- mean(hist_r)
    proj_r_mean <- mean(proj_r)
    diff_r <- (proj_r_mean - hist_r_mean) / hist_r_mean
    drv_rast_list[[d]] <- diff_r
  }
  if(length(drv_rast_list) > 1) {
    diff_r <- mean(drv_rast_list[[1]], drv_rast_list[[2]])
  }

  mdl_rast_list[[m]] <- diff_r
}
mdl_rast <- rast(mdl_rast_list)
```

### Gapfill model layers

```{r}
rast_gapfill <- function(r, w = 3, iter = 5) {
  if(iter == 1) {
    r_focal <- focal(r, w = 3, fun = "mean", na.policy = "only", na.rm = TRUE)

    r_filled <- cover(r, r_focal)
    ### cover() returns r where r is non-NA, and r_focal elsewhere
    return(r_filled)
  }

  r_filled <- r

  for (i in seq_len(iter)) {
    na_count_before <- global(is.na(r_filled), "sum")[[1]]
    r_focal  <- focal(r_filled, w = 3, fun = "mean", na.policy = "only", na.rm = TRUE)
    r_filled <- cover(r_filled, r_focal)
    na_count_after <- global(is.na(r_filled), "sum")[[1]]
    message(sprintf("Iter %d: %d NAs -> %d NAs\n", i, na_count_before, na_count_after))
    if (all(na_count_after == 0 | na_count_after == na_count_before)) break
  }
  return(r_filled)
}
```

```{r}
mdl_rast_filled <- rast_gapfill(mdl_rast)
```

### Summarize ensemble

For the ensemble model layers, reproject to Behrmann 5k resolution, mask, and calculate summary stats.  Agreement will be how many layers agree in direction of effect: 

* convert to +1/-1 sign_r
* sum sign_r
* possible values:
    * 0 means 3+, 3-
    * 2 (or -2) means 4+, 2- (or 2+, 4-)
    * 4 (or -4) means 5 in agreement
    * 6 (or -6) means total agreement.

```{r}
isimip_f <- here('_output/impact_maps/biomass_change_ssp585_2050.tif')

if(!file.exists(isimip_f)) {
  ocean_r <- get_ocean_rast()

  mdl_rast_behr <- project(mdl_rast_filled, ocean_r) |> 
    mask(ocean_r)

  mean_r <- mean(mdl_rast_behr)
  sd_r   <- app(mdl_rast_behr, fun = "sd")

  ### create a +/- raster to check agreement of direction
  sign_r <- mdl_rast_behr / abs(mdl_rast_behr)
  agr_r <- sum(sign_r)

  isimip_r <- c(mean_r, sd_r, agr_r) |> 
    setNames(c('mean_ssp585_2050', 'sd_ssp585_2050', 'agreement_ssp585_2050'))

  writeRaster(isimip_r, isimip_f)
}
```
